CleanShot X


TEAM ACCESS



Bring CleanShot under central access management



Hi there,




Configure centrally managed access for a Mac team with SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud.




CleanShot Pro combines those team-access features with CleanShot’s screenshot and screen-recording app for Mac. This gives IT a team configuration to consider, rather than viewing CleanShot only as an individual capture tool.




The Pro plan costs $10 per user per month, billed annually. Each intended seat requires macOS 13.0 or newer, making it straightforward to identify eligible users and calculate the annual plan cost.




The pricing page lays out the Pro offer, including centralized access management, SSO and SCIM, so you can decide whether it fits your team.



 


Review CleanShot Pro
